title: Outbreak
description: Every [blue]10[/blue] times you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: Every [blue]3[/blue] times you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: ⚠️ Source-of-truth discrepancy: localization description text shows '10', but code threshold is hardcoded to 3 applications (RepeatVar constant). Smart description corrected to match code. Displays counter of poison applications. {Amount} is resolved at runtime to the power's damage value.
